name: What is the difference between a rough carpenter and a trim carpenter?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a rough carpenter and a trim carpenter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rough carpenters focus on the structural framework of a building, such as framing walls, roofs, and floors. Their work is typically concealed by other finishes. Trim carpenters, conversely, specialize in the visible, decorative elements that complete the interior of a space, like baseboards, crown molding, and door casings. Maine Results, Inc. provides both framing and finish carpentry services, offering a comprehensive approach to your construction needs from structural beginnings to detailed finishes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Rough carpenters build structural frameworks, while trim carpenters install decorative interior finishes. Maine Results, Inc. offers both services.
